text.body:
Saṃvarodaya ch. 16
Ms \L = RAS London, Hodgson 38, 42r5--43r1
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pañcāmṛtasya sādhanam |
yena samyagvidhānena sarvasiddhiphalodayam ||
brāhmaṇagarbhasaṃjāta[ṃ] gṛhṇayed vidhito pitam (?) |
% brāhmaṇa°] \eme (meaning brāhmaṇī, see Padminī), brāhmaṇe \L
% vidhigopitam?
tasmād vairocanaṃ nāma khyāsiddhiś (?) ca saṃmatā ||
śyāmavarṇā subhadrāṅgī kṛṣṇatārakalocanā |
tasmād ratnakulī prāptaḥ sādhayet sūtragopitam ||
% mūtra?
saṃpūrṇakṛtaguptaṃ tu saubhāgī taruṇapadminī |
kh{y}ādyapānena saṃpūjya sarva[ṃ] dadyād vicakṣaṇa[ḥ] ||
tatkṣaṇe kunduru[ṃ] kāryam anyonyaṃ śukraṃ tu grāhayet |
tasmān naṭakulaṃ nāma vyāpite ca tathāgataḥ ||
pūrvoktavidhānena saṃpūrṇasiddhikāyate |
ādipuṣpa[ṃ] praśasta[ṃ] syā[d] ojakānti prakīrtitā ||
samayā yadi saṃprāpya mātaṅgī savayet sadā |
māṃsamadhyaṃ tathā raktaṃ grāhayet suvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
pañcāṅkuśa[ṃ] yathāprāptaṃ hatasaṃ (?) śreṣṭham ihocyate |
yadi saṃprāpya saṃgrāhya sādhaka[ḥ] siddhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||
ātmasaṃ hayamā[ṃ]saṃ [ca] hastimāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca |
% gomāṃsaṃ?
naramāṃsaṃ kukuṭamāṃsaṃ grāhayec ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
% nara°] \conj, cara° \ms
pañcapradīpam ākhyātaṃ vajrasattvavaco yathā |
daśaṣāṃ carṣaṇī (?) prāptam etad vastu samīhayet ||
% daśamīparvaṇaṃ?
sugandhamiśritaṃ yojyaṃ rahasya nantu kārayet |
% rahasyaṃ na tu ?
gulikāṃ kārayet samyak sādhakena tu gopitam ||
tatkṣaṇena tu saṃpūrṇaṃ khānapānaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
gaṇamadhye pratiṣṭhantu paścāt karma samārabhet ||
% gaṇa°] \conj, nāma° \L
catuṣkār (?) mantrajāpaṃ ca sarvakarmaphalodayam |
% mantrajāpaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ?
rasāyanaṃ śarīrasya siddhidaṃ paramākṣaram ||
gulikāṃ sevayen nityaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
% gulikāṃ] \eme, guli \L • sevayen] \eme, sevayes \L
sarvakarmaprayogeṣu sidhyate khecarīpadam ||
iti śrīsamvarodayamahātantre pañcāmṛtasādhanavidhinirdrśapaṭalaḥ ṣoḍaśamaḥ ||
